$description: Statistic V2 Component Contract. Compact data-display presentation with runtime value formatting and lifecycle feedback states.

stateLayers.state: default, loading, empty or error lifecycle presentation
stateLayers.content: runtime title, numeric value and affixes

compositionRules: Statistic is the canonical public identity for this data-display pattern; DataDisplay is a historical alias and is not a competing public component.
Statistic presents one value with optional title, prefix and suffix. It is not a Card, Chart, Table, dataset container, sorting control or filtering control.
Size changes presentation density; it does not create a separate value or content family.

Loading, Empty and Error are runtime lifecycle states. Loading uses the shared dynamic skeleton/spinner treatment; Empty and Error replace the value presentation without changing the component identity.
Numeric formatting, locale, precision, grouping and the underlying value are runtime data/configuration, not Tokens.
